title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 422 (Expeditious disposal by Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal)

content.overview: The Tribunal and the Appellate Tribunal shall dispose of proceedings as expeditiously as possible, and endeavour to do so within three months, with reasons recorded if the period is extended.
content.glance: The Tribunal and the Appellate Tribunal shall dispose of proceedings as expeditiously as possible, and endeavour to do so within three months, with reasons recorded if the period is extended.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 422 (Expeditious disposal by Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal). The Tribunal and the Appellate Tribunal shall dispose of proceedings as expeditiously as possible, and endeavour to do so within three months, with reasons recorded if the period is extended. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Tribunal and the Appellate Tribunal shall dispose of proceedings as expeditiously as possible, and endeavour to do so within three months, with reasons recorded if the period is extended.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The three-month period is a target, not a jurisdictional bar. An extension needs reasons. The section does not invalidate an order passed later.
